name: Waterline
description: Still water shot at its surface: above the line calm light, below it olive caustics.
lighting: Soft top light with caustics shimmering below the waterline
subject: either
prompt: The frame is split by the surface of still, clear water, the camera level with the waterline so the world above and the refracted world below both show. Above the line there is a pale olive-green plaster wall in warm diffuse light; below it the water glows a translucent olive and bronze, with soft shifting caustic patterns across a smooth pale stone floor. A few small bubbles cling below the surface, and the meniscus draws one bright, slightly curved line across the full width. Behind, the far wall of the pool fades into soft olive haze. Everything is calm, quiet and bathed in soft top light.
